spec.title: Judges score hackathon submissions
spec.overview: Judges at a Riyadh innovation hackathon open each team submission, give it a score and see the ranking update. Admins watch the same ranking.

cards.title: A judge scores a team submission
cards.storyline: Noura opens a submission from the smart water metering team, enters a score and saves it. A score above the maximum is refused with a clear message.

checks.title: Save a valid score
checks.do: Open a submission, type 8 in the score box and press Save.
checks.expect: The score is saved and shown on the submission page.

checks.title: Refuse a score above the maximum
checks.do: Type 15 in the score box and press Save.
checks.expect: A message says the score must be between 1 and 10 and nothing is saved.

checks.title: Judge sees the ranking
checks.do: Open the leaderboard as a judge.
checks.expect: Teams are listed from the highest average score to the lowest.

cards.title: An admin watches the ranking
cards.storyline: Faisal opens the leaderboard and the hackathon list to follow the judging.

checks.title: Admin sees the ranking
checks.do: Open the leaderboard as an admin.
checks.expect: Teams are listed from the highest average score to the lowest.

checks.title: Hackathon list opens
checks.expect: The page opens and lists the hackathons without an error.
